strength.title: SoulStrength
strength.description: The existing Soulanova Strength program: 36 workouts across three levels.
strength.notice: Five pinned master demonstrations are available. Twelve historical review clips still need final-master confirmation. Full workout playback, warm-up/cooldown and progress sync are not enabled here.

workouts.title: Strength Foundations
workouts.description: A steady full-body introduction with five familiar movements.
workouts.guidance: Begin with a comfortable load. Keep each repetition smooth, and take extra rest whenever you need it.

exercises.instruction: Hold one dumbbell close to your chest. Sit down with control, then stand tall.
exercises.name: Goblet Squat

exercises.instruction: Press both dumbbells smoothly and keep the movement within a comfortable range.
exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press

exercises.instruction: Keep your upper arms quiet and curl without swinging your torso.
exercises.name: Standing Bicep Curls

exercises.instruction: Rise onto your toes and lower slowly. Use a stable support if balance is uncertain.
exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise

exercises.instruction: Sit upright and rotate gently from your torso. Use a comfortable range; no load is required.
exercises.name: Russian Twists
